power-interest-grid.why: Explicitly uses a Power × Interest grid with all four named quadrants (Manage Closely, Keep Satisfied, Keep Informed, Monitor) and places named stakeholders in each.

tailored-engagement.why: Detailed table covers every stakeholder with what they care about, what they need, specific cadence, and channel. Clearly differentiated per stakeholder, not a uniform approach.

champions-blockers.why: Dedicated champions and blockers sections with named individuals, specific reasons for each role, and concrete activation/mitigation plans. Even notes the same person (Head of Customer Success) can be both.

distinct-axes.why: Explicitly differentiates high-power/low-interest (CEO, CFO, VP Engineering) from low-power/high-interest (Support Team, Power Users, Analytics), demonstrating clear conceptual separation of the two axes.

revisit.why: A dedicated 'Revisit' section lists specific stakeholders with named triggers that would cause their position to shift, e.g. CEO moving to Manage Closely if a major customer complains.
